hypotheses.reasoning: Trigger: rolling deploy of payment-svc v1.11.0 at 08:19:55 (#275) drained payment-svc-1 (capacity 3/4, #280) until 08:20:33 (#284). order-service then retried PaymentClient.charge immediately with backoff disabled (#282, #292, #297, #301), amplifying load on payment-svc: inbound 3.2x to 5.0x baseline (#288, #299, #306). payment-svc shed load with 503 queue full (#294, #300, #310). The gateway 503s are downstream symptoms. The failure persisted after capacity was restored because retry amplification was self-sustaining. Postgres, redis and order-consumer look healthy.

verdict.recommendedAction: Enable exponential backoff with jitter and a bounded retry budget in order-service PaymentClient (retries currently run with backoff disabled), so retry traffic stops amplifying load on payment-svc and its queue can drain. Hold or roll back the payment-svc v1.11.0 rollout until a canary confirms normal load handling, and make rollouts keep full capacity (surge before drain). Alert on retry rate and on payment-svc inbound rate over baseline.
